elements.label: Live-action footage: top-down coffee cup cuts to woman sipping from a cup
elements.change_other: hard cut between footage clips matched on the coffee cup, then in-clip subject motion (cup lowers, head tilts down)

pattern.description: A top-down shot of a hand lifting a coffee cup hard-cuts to a frontal shot of a woman drinking from a cup, the cup carrying the eye across the cut.
pattern.why_premium: The shared object (the cup) links two unrelated angles so the cut reads as continuous action instead of a jump, giving a cinematic, story-led rhythm.

build_hint.gsap: No tween: a timeline hard cut (tl.set(clipA, {autoAlpha: 0}) / tl.set(clipB, {autoAlpha: 1}) at the same time), with the cup positioned near the same frame region in both clips; optional subtle tl.fromTo(clipB, {scale: 1.02}, {scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Two <Sequence> blocks back to back with <OffthreadVideo> clips, no transition; align the cup's screen position across the cut; optional scale interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [1.02, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}).

notes: Live-action footage, not UI motion. Camera verdict is none; the motion is a cut plus subject movement. The match on the cup is loose (different angle and different cup).
